Getting Started as a Front-End Developer

26 Aug 2025 - Posted by Abdul-Mumin Rufai

I was placed at a Busy Internet, a telecommunication company, to do my national service. At Busy Internet, I met a lot of senior staff and colleagues. At the I.T. department, I had the opportunity to work with Mr. Emmanuel Bull, the head of the department. He has a lot of skills and experience in the I.T. sector. He mentored me and helped me gain more practical skills needed for my career growth. He recommended a programming course for me on Udemy, which I bought and learnt more.

Internship at Noble Grafixs and Advertersing Limited.

After the national service, because of a good relationship between me and one of my colleagues, he had employment at Noble Grafix, and he was able to link me up when the opportunity came to do an internship, where I am currently.

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Having on experience with networks technology such as cambium network.
  • Gain experience in backend programming with flask and Django frameworks.
  • Gain a lot of communicating skill as I normally interact with client and customers.

Mr. Solomon and I at Noble Grafixs have ventured into the small-scale livestock rearing business, which is a significant step toward our growth. With my communication skills, ability to tolerate others' views, ability to work in a group, and ability to help others. I am confident that these qualities will help me get in touch with people all over the World, which will enable me to build strong connections and relationships in the Chevening community and beyond, and adhere to the core values of the Chevening scholarship.
